requests.prompt: A polished video-game title logo. Clean, bold, slightly italic geometric letterforms with a subtle bevel, as if cut from the same coloured blocks as the game's world: each letter a different colour of the palette coral, tangerine, butter yellow, mint, teal, periwinkle, lilac, with a thin white highlight on the top edges and a soft deep-indigo outline and drop shadow so it reads on both a bright sky and a dark screen. No other text, no watermark. The single word "GLIDERS" in capitals, spelled exactly G-L-I-D-E-R-S. A soft swoosh of contrail curves from under the G up and over the word to end in a small sparkle above the final S, as if something just glided past. Wide landscape composition, the word filling about 85% of the width, even margins. Transparent background (PNG with alpha). If transparency is not possible, use a flat pure magenta #FF00FF background with nothing else on it and no cast shadow; it is keyed out on integration. Output composition aspect ratio 5:2, target 1600 x 640 pixels.

Polished stylised 3D render, like key art for an indie flying game: soft global illumination, gentle rim light, clean shapes, rich but not garish colour, strong sense of speed and depth. The animals are appealing stylised versions of the real species, anatomically recognisable, not cartoon mascots with human expressions. No text, no watermark, no UI, no photographic noise. The world of Gliders: huge abstract structures of clean geometric blocks (towers, arches, hollow frames, tunnels, slabs and spires) floating in an endless soft sky above a sea of clouds, in the style of the game Superflight. The blocks are flat-coloured with crisp edges and soft light, in a vivid but harmonious palette (coral, tangerine, butter yellow, mint, teal, periwinkle, lilac), fading into pastel atmospheric haze with distance. A wide establishing view: in the middle distance a flying squirrel and a four-winged Microraptor glide side by side through a tall coral and teal arch, trailing thin glowing contrails (one aqua, one gold), while a flying fish with its blue pectoral fins spread skims past a tangerine tower in the foreground on the right. Bright late-afternoon light, peach and lavender sky, clouds far below. Keep the upper-middle third calm and open (soft sky and distant blocks only) for the logo, and the bottom-right corner quiet for buttons. Full-bleed 16:9, no border. Target 1920 x 1080 pixels, 16:9 aspect ratio.

corrections.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this paradise tree snake game portrait. Preserve the stylised 3D rendering, warm upper-left light, glossy black scales edged vivid green, red-orange dorsal spots, head looking toward viewer, square composition and true transparent background. Change only body anatomy: REMOVE the two huge triangular wing-like flaps entirely. Snakes have NO wings, fins, limbs, ribs protruding as wings, or membranes. Make the animal one continuous slender flattened ribbon body of consistent modest width, tapering toward its tail, flowing through a broad horizontal S-shaped airborne wave. Slight flattening of the actual trunk is sufficient; do not widen into manta-ray shapes. Keep the full animal within the frame with 8 percent clear margin. Transparent PNG, target 512 x 512.
